about.metaDescription: Shigra is a healthy lifestyle community built on trust, transparency, and real impact. Learn about our mission, vision, and values.
about.title: A Community Built on Trust
about.description: Shigra was born from the belief that every family deserves honest information and access to a sustainable healthy lifestyle — without manipulation.
about.storyP1: Shigra began from concern about the proliferation of health products and claims unsupported by scientific evidence and official regulations. Honest consumers wanting to live healthily are often trapped by misleading information.
about.storyP2: We chose the transparent path: building a community that prioritizes fact-based education, full transparency, and compliance with BPOM & BSN regulations. This isn't about selling products — it's about building a trustworthy healthy lifestyle ecosystem.
about.storyP3: Our three main pillars — Air (clean air), Water (quality water), and Food (healthy food) — reflect our belief that holistic health starts from a clean environment and proper nutrition.
about.value1Desc: Building a healthy, environmentally conscious community through access to clean air, quality water, and healthy food — without exaggerated claims.
about.value2Desc: Becoming a trusted community platform connecting Indonesian families with affordable and sustainable healthy lifestyles.
about.value3Desc: Transparency in every piece of information, strict regulatory compliance, and real social impact are the main foundations of Shigra.
about.value4Desc: We are committed to not misleading consumers. All information we convey is based on facts, technical data, and official regulations.
about.regulatoryDesc: Shigra operates in accordance with BPOM RI regulations and other related requirements. We do not make medical claims or treatment promises unsupported by valid scientific evidence.

product.metaDescription: Shigra SM-S230XNA product details — Water Machine with multi-stage filtration system. Technical information, specifications, and product operation.
product.subtitle: Shigra Water Machine — Multi-Stage Filtration Technology
product.description: A high-precision water processing machine combining multi-stage filtration with a 350W SMPS control system for technically measured daily drinking water needs.
product.regulatoryText: This product is a drinking water processing device. Shigra does not claim this product treats or cures any disease.
product.filter1Desc: Filters large physical particles such as sediment, rust, and deposits from water lines.
product.filter2Desc: High-precision secondary filtration to capture fine particles that pass through the initial stage.
product.filter3Desc: Natural mineral material that helps condition water and bind residual chlorine molecules.
product.filter4Desc: Maintains calcium involvement and essential natural minerals in a balanced range.
product.filter5Desc: Significantly reduces odor, unpleasant taste, chlorine residue, and certain organic compounds.
product.filter6Desc: 0.01μm ultra-filtration membrane as the main guard filtering microscopic contaminants.
product.claimed2: 350W SMPS power system and 12 titanium plates
product.claimed3: Water pH adjustment from 2.5 to 12 for various technical needs
product.notClaimed1: Not claimed to cure any medical condition
product.notClaimed2: Not a substitute for medication or professional medical therapy
product.notClaimed3: No miraculous claims without verified scientific support

community.description: The Shigra community provides a collaborative space to learn, share knowledge, and support each other in achieving a healthier quality of life.
community.feature1Desc: A space to share experiences and ask about healthy lifestyles rationally and objectively.
community.feature2Desc: Access to verified articles, research, and practical guides from trusted independent sources.
community.feature3Desc: Regular online and offline meetings with practitioners and academics.
community.feature4Desc: Active involvement in providing nutritious food and subsidizing community clean water access.
community.principlesDesc: We strictly maintain the Shigra community to be free from sales intimidation or aggressive promotion. Our main focus is education and mutual support among members.

community.testimonial1Text: What I value most about Shigra is its honesty. No purchase pressure or exaggerated promises. Discussions focus on educational facts.
community.testimonial2Text: Seeing a community focused on understanding water filtration and air quality scientifically is very refreshing. A very positive initiative.
community.testimonial3Text: The clean water social program and healthy food education have greatly helped our family understand the importance of quality water and food.

legalitas.metaDescription: Official legality documents and certifications for Shigra products. We are committed to full transparency.
legalitas.title: Transparency Without Compromise
legalitas.description: We only communicate honest legal status. Official documents are displayed openly after all licensing processes are complete.
legalitas.warningText: The label "Testing/Licensing Process" indicates that we are currently following official administrative channels. Shigra does not display fake certification badges without valid verification documents.
legalitas.sniDesc: SNI certification ensures products meet safety and technical quality standards set by the Republic of Indonesia government.
legalitas.sniNote: Shigra is undergoing periodic testing procedures. Official documents will be displayed in full after all stages are complete.
legalitas.bpomAuthority: National Agency of Drug and Food Control (BPOM RI)
legalitas.bpomDesc: BPOM distribution license is mandatory for devices related to drinking water to ensure safety and prevent misleading medical claims.
legalitas.bpomNote: The registration and licensing process is underway according to regulations. Shigra complies with the limitation that no health claims are made before official licensing is issued.
legalitas.labDesc: Water quality and filtration capability testing by accredited independent laboratories to objectively verify specification data.
legalitas.labNote: Laboratory test reports will be published openly for public access.
legalitas.isoDesc: ISO certification guarantees manufacturing feasibility standards and international-scale product quality management.
legalitas.isoNote: The international certification document evaluation process is being carried out with manufacturing partners.
legalitas.ref1Title: BPOM Clarification on Water Processing Devices
legalitas.ref1Desc: BPOM emphasizes that water processing devices may not claim to cure diseases miraculously. Shigra fully supports this principle.
legalitas.ref2Title: SNI Standards for Drinking Water & Devices
legalitas.ref2Desc: Technical quality reference provisions and device safety standards in Indonesia.
legalitas.ref3Desc: Guidelines for drinking water quality requirements and environmental hygiene.

socialImpact.metaDescription: Shigra's social programs: free meals, clean water subsidies, and partner village communities. Real commitment to Indonesian society.
socialImpact.title: Social Responsibility Is Our Core Mission
socialImpact.description: For Shigra, business existence must bring concrete benefits to the environment and others. Our social programs are not supplements — they are the main reason why we exist.
socialImpact.program1Desc: Providing balanced nutritious meals monthly for communities in need around the Shigra community work area.
socialImpact.program1Detail: Collaborating with local organic farmers to ensure nutrition quality while empowering the local economy.
socialImpact.program2Desc: Subsidy program for providing clean water filtration facilities for underprivileged families.
socialImpact.program2Detail: Data collection is done openly with local village officials to ensure aid reaches the right recipients.
socialImpact.program3Desc: Supporting selected villages in building sanitation systems, clean water management, and independent nutrition gardens.
socialImpact.program3Detail: Encouraging village residents' independence through ongoing training and field mentoring.
